SESSION	CREATE OR REPLACE TEMPORARY VIEW view1 AS SELECT 2 AS i1
READ	SELECT view1.* FROM view1
READ	SELECT * FROM view1
READ	SELECT view1.i1 FROM view1
READ	SELECT i1 FROM view1
READ	SELECT a.i1 FROM view1 AS a
READ	SELECT i1 FROM view1 AS a
SESSION	DROP VIEW view1
DDL	CREATE OR REPLACE GLOBAL TEMPORARY VIEW view1 as SELECT 1 as i1
READ	SELECT * FROM global_temp.view1
READ	SELECT global_temp.view1.* FROM global_temp.view1
READ	SELECT i1 FROM global_temp.view1
READ	SELECT global_temp.view1.i1 FROM global_temp.view1
READ	SELECT view1.i1 FROM global_temp.view1
READ	SELECT a.i1 FROM global_temp.view1 AS a
READ	SELECT i1 FROM global_temp.view1 AS a
DDL	DROP VIEW global_temp.view1
